## Pros

- Toddler seat approved from birth to 50 lb with no add-on (US manual 260710).
- UPPAbaby sells it as a Kona + Aria V2 bundle; the seat "attaches directly" (bundle page, help centre 2026-09-25).
- Lighter than the Cruz V3 and Vista V3 (22 lb, maker); folds with the seat on either way; travel bag needs no wheel removal ($149.99).

## Cons

Misuse risks come first.

- **Misuse risk:** no manual describes attaching the Aria V2 to the Kona or checking it. The Kona manual has no car seat section, and the Aria V2 manual (rev. 260724) does not list the Kona.
- **Misuse risk:** UPPAbaby's bundle page says the carrier can face outward on the Kona; the Aria V2 manual allows parent-facing only.
- Ride over bumps is "good, but not great", rougher than the Cruz and Vista (Babylist); seat sits low and the handlebar wobbles when fully extended.
- Fold gets stuck for some owners (low confidence); no measured weight or fold; only one hands-on write-up.
- Does not fit the 22 x 14 x 9 in overhead bin.
